status: exploratory hypothetical sensitivity plan; not independently preregistered
initial_state: One normalized molecular equivalent of fully absorbed parent; no pre-existing metabolite
half_life_evidence: 4.1 and 3.1 h are caffeine/paraxanthine group values in a six-male-volunteer primary study (PMID3756065); 2 and 8 h are chosen sensitivity values, not a population interval
formation_assumption: Chosen sensitivity fractions; all metabolite types collapsed into one paraxanthine-like state. No human pathway fraction is estimated.
weight_assumption: Arbitrary active-equivalent weights, not measured receptor affinities, effects or sleep potency
event_assumption: All hypothetical mechanisms begin at hour2 with immediate systemic availability; capture is instantaneous and irreversible, with no rebound or capacity limit
limits: No oral absorption or gut compartment
No tissue distribution or BBB kinetics
No receptor binding/unbinding or endogenous adenosine
No binder structure, capacity or kinetics
No sleep or other clinical endpoint
